about: The Workbench icons of the Micropolis drawer: python3 AMICRADLE/scripts/port_icons.py amiga/icons/icons.json --out <dir> (amiga/Makefile.amigaos runs it). The art (art/micropolis.svg, drawn as an OS 3.5 GlowIcon: shaped, shaded, see-through round the edges) is The AmiCradle Team's own, under the same terms as the other Amiga files; art/micropolis.png is it rendered at 128 x 128. Micropolis-drawer.info is the drawer's own icon, installed as Micropolis.info beside it. City.info goes on CITY.CTY and every bundled city, and as icons/def_city.info it is the icon the game gives each city it saves, its default tool then set to the program; CityIn.info is the bundled cities' copy, whose default tool is one drawer up.
